description: Session expiry times are renewed only under the configured refresh rules.

cases.description: With automatic refresh enabled, a successful authenticated request extends the stored expiry and the token remains usable beyond its original expiry until the renewed expiry is passed.
cases.expected_output:
check1.status=200
check1.url=/api/
check1.body=User is authenticated.
check1.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T15:00:00
check2.status=200
check2.url=/api/
check2.body=User is authenticated.
check2.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T21:00:00
check3.status=401
check3.url=/api/
check3.detail=Invalid token.
check3.stored_expiry=null
original_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00

cases.description: With automatic refresh disabled, a successful authenticated request does not change the stored expiry timestamp.
cases.expected_output:
check1.status=200
check1.url=/api/
check1.body=User is authenticated.
check1.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00
original_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00

cases.description: With automatic refresh enabled, a request inside the minimum refresh write interval succeeds without rewriting the stored expiry timestamp.
cases.expected_output:
check1.status=200
check1.url=/api/
check1.body=User is authenticated.
check1.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00
original_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00

cases.description: With automatic refresh enabled and a maximum session age configured, renewal is capped at that maximum and the token is rejected after the capped expiry.
cases.expected_output:
check1.status=200
check1.url=/api/
check1.body=User is authenticated.
check1.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T12:00:00
check2.status=401
check2.url=/api/
check2.detail=Invalid token.
check2.stored_expiry=null
original_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00
